1.flavor_text:
What's wrong? Come on, let's settle this head-on, no tricks!
— Kuroshiba

2.name: Winged Kegen
2.flavor_text:
Who's causing trouble around here? This Winged Kegen will take flight to protect her master!
— Winged Kegen

4.flavor_text:
I'll seal your every move, and nullify your Barrier too!
— Kurobo-chan

5.flavor_text:
Call me and I'll come running, attacking at full force! I'm the Faceless Rider!
— Faceless Rider

6.flavor_text: Once the Phantom Carriage sets its sights on you, it's over! There's nowhere to run or hide!

7.effect:
●Resonance: Raiga (If the Horobeat using this Waza is of the Raiga tribe, this Waza gains the following effects.)

  • When this Waza is used, draw 1 card.

  • This Waza gets +1000 Power.
7.flavor_text: Layer your beat on top of mine! Overbeat!!

8.flavor_text:
Your beat shook me to the core. With that spirit and strength, I know we can be the ultimate duo. Fight alongside me, Jin!
— Raiju Leo

9.flavor_text: A tiny-bodied, cute little kitten. Yet this is the fearsome Raiju Leo's disguise as he moves through the world.

10.flavor_text: There was a small and utterly charming kitten, none other than the Raiju Leo, in his guise as he walks among the human world.

12.flavor_text: Quietly watching over Hinata, making her nightly rounds as always. This is the story of a time when no one yet knew Nanaocchi's true form.

15.flavor_text: "Horobeat," a battle for the survival of yokai-kind. Those who triumph will become the King of the Night Parade, ruler of all Horobeats. Some fight to protect, some to satisfy their desires, some to reach the top... Both humans and Horobeats rose up, each carrying their own hopes in their hearts.

16.flavor_text: Some Horobeats lived their lives hidden from human eyes. In fact, many yokai had attached themselves to Ukaji Hinata, a girl living in an old temple, yet she herself had no idea at all.

21.flavor_text: Even "Horobeat," the battle for survival, had its unspoken rules. Even so, no small number of fighters schemed to break them with surprise attacks.

24.flavor_text: Raiju Leo formed a contract with Narumi Jin and became a Horobeat who fights alongside him. To lead their imperiled comrades, to save their allies from the brink of destruction: that was the great wish Leo harbored within.

27.name: Beast Beat Hihihime
27.flavor_text:
To win this battle, it seems you'd better master the art of Overbeat!!
— Beast Beat Hihihime

28.effect:
●Resonance: Raiga (If the Horobeat using this Waza is of the Raiga tribe, this Waza gains the following effects.)

  • When this Waza is used, draw 1 card.

  • This Waza gets +1000 Power.

30.flavor_text:
On a dark road at night, if you hear chirps of "chi-chi" from ahead and from behind, it is surely a flock of Yosuzume, the Horobeats that warn of misfortune.
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 3: Birds~

32.flavor_text: All Horobeats harbor dangerously immense power within them. A Horobeat that has unleashed its full power transforms into its true form, the combat state known as "Horobeast," and brings its genuine strength to bear.

35.name: Oni Beat Yuki
35.effect: ●When this Horobeat enters play, choose one of your Ena and place it in the graveyard.

37.name: Beat Burst: Thunder Cherry Blossom Lightning

38.name: Beat Burst: Thunder Cherry Blossom Lightning

39.effect: ●When this Waza is used, deal 1 damage to the opposing player. However, this effect cannot deal the finishing blow.

44.flavor_text:
Wandering crossroad slashers, three siblings. We're the ones pulling the strings in this town from the shadows. That's the Kamabuki Trading Co. for ya.
— Kamaitachi Kamaji

46.name: Raijin Overbeat Leojin
46.flavor_text: Leo and Jin. The form born when their two hearts become one, that is "Leojin"!

50.flavor_text: In ages past, the people were swallowed by a tide of frenzy. A flame born of sacred fire burned without cease, ever seeking the rapture of old. Shinazui burns on still, in secret.

51.name: Undying Shinazui
51.flavor_text:
Our fire will never go out. That burning soul of yours, you feel it too, don't you?
— Undying Shinazui

53.flavor_text: Nishikaze Iroha was frail, but she dreamed of the open sky, hoping that one day, like her family of pilots, she too could soar. That's when, drifting floatily before her, a tsukumono airplane appeared.

55.name: Forest Spirit Kegen
55.flavor_text: The secret technique passed down among Horobeats: "Barrier." It is a technique for protecting oneself from attack, and has been handed down among gentle Horobeats who prefer to avoid conflict.

56.name: Hitorima
56.flavor_text: Yokai and strange beings passed down in legends the world over. They have quietly lived alongside humans, keeping pace with civilization. But as civilization advanced, people forgot about them, and they found themselves facing the brink of extinction. In time, they came to be called "Horobeats."

57.flavor_text: For Horobeats, Ena is the very source of their strength. By mastering "Ena Reading," the art of controlling the flow of Ena, one can draw out even greater power.

58.effect: ●If the number of cards under this Horobeat is greater than the number of cards under the opposing Horobeat, this Waza gets +2000 Power.

59.effect: ●Only a Horobeat in lines 1–2 can use this Waza.
59.flavor_text:
Looking good! You're shredded! Your Power's going up!
— Muscle Mukimuki Oni

61.name: Taverna and Futakuchi Girl
61.flavor_text:
Now, please, take your time and enjoy your meal, my lovely guest. I do need you to eat plenty and put on some weight...
— Taverna

As expected of the chef, what a fine eye you have. After all, it's the beautiful ones whose bodies hold the richest flavor.
— Futakuchi Girl

63.name: Sho and Shinazui Soaring Through the Night
63.flavor_text: Leo and Jin walk forward together, leading their allies. Shinazui and Sho fight in solitude, seeking a single blazing flame. The two pairs were polar opposites, yet the path they had to take against great evil was one and the same.

65.effect:
●If the total number of cards under your Horobeats in lines 1–2 is 3 or more, this Horobeat gets +3000 Power and gains Double Damage.

(When a Horobeat with Double Damage wins a battle, it deals 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

66.effect:
●If the total number of cards under your Horobeats in lines 1–2 is 3 or more, this Horobeat gets +3000 Power and gains Double Damage.

(When a Horobeat with Double Damage wins a battle, it deals 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

67.name: Kui Beat Tavelle
67.flavor_text: Overbeat: the ultimate technique in which a Horobeat and their contractor fuse together to obtain overwhelming power.

68.flavor_text: The members of the Yurufuwa Club are a fun bunch who gathered together for everyone's sake.

69.effect:
●Resonance: Suzaku (If the Horobeat using this Waza is of the Suzaku tribe, this Waza gains the following effects.)

  • When this Waza is used, your opponent chooses 1 card from their hand and discards it.

  • When this battle is won, you draw 1 card.
69.flavor_text: Shinazui, ever hungry for excitement, had taken a liking to Ariake Sho, not for his strength or agility, but because he sensed in his hidden heart a flame that would never go out. With each battle they fought together under their contract, the bond between the two grew ever stronger.

70.effect: ●If you go first this round, this Waza gets +2000 Power.

71.flavor_text: Rare Kegen's Rare Case Lecture! If you take Double Damage when you have no Hearts remaining, 1 Barrier won't be enough to stop it and you'll be defeated. But with 2 Barrier, you won't take the finishing blow, so you can still fight on, ya hear!

72.effect:
●While this Horobeat is in a line, its cost is 1 lower.

●When a card other than [Zoom Drone] is Overbeat onto this Horobeat, draw 1 card.

73.effect:
●This Horobeat cannot use Waza.

●If the opposing Horobeat is using a Waza, this Horobeat gets +4000 Power.
73.flavor_text: Never grovel. Never yield. Push the limits of battle and elevate your kin through the struggle. That is the way of the Suzaku Blood, a proud and solitary clan of birds who bow to no one.

74.name: Horobeast Shinazui
74.flavor_text: When Jin and Leo found themselves cornered in battle, it was Sho and Shinazui who came to their aid. Close in age and both fighting alongside their Horobeats, the two also came to burn with a fierce rivalry toward one another.

75.flavor_text:
A car Horobeat with a huge face on it, said to appear suddenly on misty moonlit nights. Its true nature is unknown, but in recent years some whisper that it may be possessed by the grudges of humans who lost a car chase. The vehicle model varies.
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 1: Vehicles~

76.effect:
●Double Damage (If this Horobeat wins a battle, deal 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

●If the total number of cards under your Horobeats in lines 1–2 is 5 or more, this Horobeat gets +5000 Power.

78.name: Thousand-Year Tree Spirit Kyodama
78.flavor_text:
Humans gain knowledge and forget the old ways. We Horobeats, too, fade quietly into nothing. How cruel a thing is the march of civilization.
— Thousand-Year Tree Spirit Kyodama

79.name: Beat Burst: Undying Eternal Flame!
79.flavor_text: The Undying Eternal Flame steals the heat from its foes, raging and burning without end. The enemy is consumed in flames, and yet freezes cold as death.

81.name: Strike First! Shinazui & Sho
81.effect:
●Ena Reading Green 3 (If you have 3 or more Green Ena in your Ena Zone, this Horobeat gains the following effect.)

  • When this Horobeat wins a battle, if it is in lines 1–2, your opponent chooses 1 card from their hand and discards it.

82.name: Strike First! Shinazui & Sho
82.effect:
●Ena Reading Green 3 (If you have 3 or more Green Ena in your Ena Zone, this Horobeat gains the following effect.)

  • When this Horobeat wins a battle, if it is in lines 1–2, your opponent chooses 1 card from their hand and discards it.

89.effect: ●If this Horobeat is using a Waza, it gets +3000 Power.

90.effect: ●If this Horobeat is using a Waza, it gets +3000 Power.
90.flavor_text: Where wrongdoing stirs in the west and a suffering child weeps in the east, in such times Kurobo-chan shall come.

95.name: Lonely Nokaze
95.flavor_text: In the present world, humans who wander into back alleys are vanishing one after another. Everyone says the same thing: "There's a many-mouthed woman, a man-eating yokai called Nokaze." But keep that under your hat... yes, lips sealed.

100.effect:
●When this Horobeat's battle ends, you may choose 1 cost-1 Waza that was used in this battle and use that card in the next line.

(Waza cannot be used in a line with no Horobeat.)

103.effect:
●Ena Reading Blue 3 (If you have 3 or more Blue Ena in your Ena Zone, this Horobeat gains the following effect.)

  • If this Horobeat is using a Waza, it gets +3000 Power and gains Double Damage.

(When a Horobeat with Double Damage wins a battle, it deals 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

104.effect: ●If this Horobeat is downed, it gets +3000 Power.

106.name: Bull Beat Headnaguru
106.effect: ●When this Horobeat's battle ends, each player may choose 1 Waza from their graveyard and place it in their Ena Zone as used.
106.flavor_text: "Overbeat": the secret art by which a Horobeat and its contracted human share a surge of mutual spirit. Their forms and souls intertwine, transforming them into a strange battle shape of immense power.

107.flavor_text: The Dokuro Gang constantly kept other tribes in check, fighting endless turf wars. And yet, lurking behind those conflicts, pulling the strings, seems to be a far greater gang...

108.effect:
●Resonance: Justice (If the Horobeat using this Waza is of the Justice tribe, this Waza gains the following effect.)

  • This Waza gets +3000 Power.

110.name: Fleeting Dreams, The World Is Yo! Yo!
110.flavor_text:
How's this floor treating ya, yo, the ideal vibe, that dim glow / Smash the truth of rise and fall, so listen up, soul's Shout!
— Manyou Brothers, debut track 'Yo! Kai! Rap'

112.effect: ●When this Horobeat is destroyed, place this card in your Ena unused instead of the graveyard.
112.flavor_text: The shadow of approaching malice, the presence of a great eight-legged creature——. Who will step up to face Jin and the others?! Next time: 'It Comes! The Dreaded Spider'! Don't miss it!

113.name: Giri Mukuro
113.flavor_text:
Regret upon regret! We Horobeats are fated to vanish, little by little. Oh, how I resent it, resent it, resent it!
— Giri Mukuro

114.effect: ●When this Horobeat enters play, each player places the top card of their deck into their Ena Zone as used.

118.name: Beat Burst: Strike of the Living Body

119.name: Beat Burst: Strike of the Living Body

121.effect: ●When you end your Summon Phase, you may choose 1 Waza with a cost of 1 in the graveyard and return it to your hand.

122.effect: ●When you end your Summon Phase, you may choose 1 Waza with a cost of 1 in the graveyard and return it to your hand.

130.flavor_text: Horobeat. It is the battle that Horobeats, fated for extinction, wage in a desperate bid to survive. It is said that whoever reaches the top will have their wish granted, and so every Horobeat carries hope or ambition in their heart.

132.name: Katakirauwa
132.flavor_text:
Katakirauwa is a pig-shaped yokai whose single ear is its charm point. Despite its looks, legend has it that if it passes between your legs, your soul will be stolen away. So in areas where Katakirauwa is said to appear, the locals all walk with their legs crossed.
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 3: Beasts~

133.name: Gale Kamaichi
133.effect: ●If this Horobeat is in lines 2–5, it gets +2500 Power.
133.flavor_text:
The entertainment district. Night after night, shady dealings rule the streets, and sometimes a blade flashes like the wind. The Kamabuki Trading Co. shows no mercy to anyone who messes with their turf.
— Kamacho, Kamaitachi Underling

134.flavor_text: Nanao, Hinata's partner, is a Mystic Fox Horobeat with seven tails. It is said that a Mystic Fox grows one new tail for every hundred years it ages, which means Nanao is actually quite ancient. According to Leo, bringing up her age is a surefire way to end up on the wrong end of a spell.

135.flavor_text:
A calamitous yokai that stirs up storms and attacks ships. Do not be startled by the shadow of a giant fish, well over 100 meters long, that appears out at sea. That one is still just a junior. They say it will one day grow to a size that could be mistaken for a continent.
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 3: Sea Beasts~

138.flavor_text:
Red-faced and red-bodied, Akana is a calm and gentle Horobeat. Long ago, she was caught up in a dispute with a cunning monkey over a peach, but was rescued by the moon, and ever since, she has lived happily on the moon.
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 3: Beasts~

140.name: Nezu Beat Kyujiro
140.effect:
●If Boost has been used on this Horobeat, it gets +3000 Power.

(Even if Boost has been used more than once, this effect only activates once.)
140.flavor_text: Thunder Rogue Kyuso and Uchino Jiro. With Overbeat, the two combine into super pitcher Kyujiro!! Now unleashing the killer breaking ball, the "Thunder Slider"!

141.effect:
●Resonance: Raiga (If the Horobeat using this Waza is of the Raiga tribe, this Waza gains the following effects.)

  • When this Waza is used, draw 1 card.

  • This Waza gets +1000 Power.

143.effect: ●If you have 4 or more Horobeats in play on the line, this Horobeat gets +4000 Power.
143.flavor_text:
Let's go, Jin! For our friends' sake, we can't afford to lose. Keep stacking those beats!
— Raiju Leo

145.name: Rai Beat Leojin
145.flavor_text: In every living thing, there is a heartbeat that resounds the moment death becomes real. When those rhythms overlap, a miracle is born. That is Fusion: "Overbeat"!

147.flavor_text: To hide himself from the world, Shinazui kept his flames burning low and small. In doing so, he took the form of a tiny firebird, just as he had appeared when first born from sacred flame. And so, calling himself "Shinazui-sama," he waited for the day he could let his fire burn bright once more.

148.flavor_text:
A Horobeat covered head to toe in fur, fond of living beneath the floorboards of damp, poorly lit houses. Considered a kind of plague spirit, it also has a capricious side that will lend a hand to humans it takes a liking to. It almost never shows itself before people, so if you spot one, lucky you? Or maybe not!
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 1: Hair~

150.flavor_text:
According to my data, Horobeats who gain a human partner tend to demonstrate even greater power, with a win rate roughly 60% higher than wild Horobeats! A most fascinating statistic, wouldn't you say, Furari?
— Science Inte

Splendid... By the pact of our proud Strange Bird bloodline, I shall lead you to glory.
— Strange Bird Furari-hi

151.flavor_text: Barrier: a secret art of protection passed down among Horobeats since ancient times. Hitodama Morun uses that power to protect its partner even in death.

152.flavor_text:
A Suzaku Blood Horobeat that beats anyone who comes near with a hammer, again and again. Despite its ferocious fighting spirit, it is said to have a careful, timid personality, though much about it remains unknown.
— 'Horobeat Compendium' ~Volume 3: Golden Birds~

155.effect: ●When a card is Overbeat onto this Horobeat, if this Horobeat is downed, draw 1 card.
155.flavor_text: The "Horobeats" fight on in hiding within modern society. They are yokai who, as civilization advanced, lost both the power and the place to live, and had been on the verge of fading away entirely.

157.name: Sho and Shinazui Soaring Through the Night
157.flavor_text: The sharp-minded Sho, the physically gifted Shinazui. Hungry for excitement, Sho was inspired by Shinazui, and kindled a burning ambition to reach greater heights, and so the two joined forces to fight together. By gathering the power of green and reading the flow of Ena, they grew even stronger.

158.name: Mana Beat Furarinte
158.flavor_text:
I see! Fusion is a combat form that draws out the Horobeat's innate qualities and the partner's talents, sublimating them into fighting power. A half-yokai combined form, as it were! Within my own mind I can clearly sense the will of Mr. Furari as well! Now that's what I call a learning experience!
— Furarinte

159.effect:
●Resonance: Suzaku (If the Horobeat using this Waza is of the Suzaku tribe, this Waza gains the following effects.)

  • When this Waza is used, your opponent chooses 1 card from their hand and discards it.

  • When this battle is won, you draw 1 card.
159.flavor_text: A secret technique passed down through the Suzaku bloodline, one that "resonates" the blood of Suzaku to unleash an explosive surge of power.

160.name: Horobeast Shinazui
160.flavor_text: Many Horobeats transform into human-like shapes to blend into the human world. But in battle, they also possess a form in which all of their power is fully unleashed. That form became known, and feared, as the Horobeast.

161.flavor_text: Jumbo's one wish is to make the dream of his partner, Nishikaze Iroha, come true. For the sake of her wish to fly freely through the sky, Jumbo keeps on soaring today, with the Jan-Jan★Engine running at full throttle.

162.name: Never Give Up! Shinazui
162.flavor_text: Suzaku Blood is a solitary bloodline. They are a clan that needs no allies; they trust only their own strength in battle. Proud to the core, they refuse to bow to their destined destruction, and keep their blood burning hotter than anyone else's in their drive to be the strongest.

163.name: Raise Beat Shinazuisho
163.effect:
●Double Damage (If this Horobeat wins a battle, deal 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

●If there are 2 or more cards under this Horobeat, it gets +3000 Power.
163.flavor_text: The living pulse that rings out from those who never break, who wish to win, and who fight to the very end. When those undefeated hearts resonate together, new power is born. This is Fusion: "Overbeat."

164.name: Raise Beat Shinazuisho
164.effect:
●Double Damage (If this Horobeat wins a battle, deal 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)

●If there are 2 or more cards under this Horobeat, it gets +3000 Power.

165.set_name: PR Card [HB-BP01 Expansion Pack Vol. 1 Horobeat BOX Bonus]

166.name: Sho and Shinazui Soaring Through the Night
166.set_name: PR Card [HB-BP01 Expansion Pack Vol. 1 Horobeat BOX Bonus]
166.flavor_text:
A battle for the crown of the supernatural. Victory will be ours.
— Shinazui

167.set_name: PR Card [HB-BP01 Expansion Pack Vol. 1 Horobeat BOX Bonus]
167.effect:
●Ena Reading Blue 3 (If you have 3 or more Blue Ena in your Ena Zone, this Horobeat gains the following effect.)

  • If this Horobeat is using a Waza, it gets +3000 Power and gains Double Damage.

(When a Horobeat with Double Damage wins a battle, it deals 2 damage to the opposing player instead of 1.)
167.flavor_text:
Now, let the curtain rise. Behold the tale of two supernatural souls, if you please!
— Kurobou

168.flavor_text: Let me tell you how we red players fight. Fill your first line, fill your second line, keep calling in allies one after another, and once you've got 4 out there, Overbeat into Leojin! Winning in one big push with everyone's combined strength is the shortest road to victory. That's our style!

169.flavor_text: When a Horobeat wins a battle, you deal damage to your opponent's Hearts. Destroy all of your opponent's Hearts and land the finishing blow. That's how you win, meow~.

170.flavor_text: When a Heart is destroyed, a trigger activates! Entry Triggers put the card straight into your line, Over Triggers transform on the spot, and the mighty Last Over Triggers can be used when you have 1 or fewer Hearts! There are also Draw Triggers to grow your hand. Turn a pinch into a chance and go for the comeback win, zo-zo-zo!

172.flavor_text: In battle, two Horobeats facing each other compete with their power. When you can't win, pay 1 Ena to use a Boost from your hand and power up. Take a look at the left side of the card. That's the Boost.

174.flavor_text: Win a battle and deal damage to both the opposing Horobeat and their Hearts. And with me, you even get a bonus: extra cards in hand! More cards means a faster path to victory. The more you win, the better it gets for Betobeto!

177.name: Overbeat Leojin
177.flavor_text: Line up 4 allies and then bring me out. Massive firepower plus Double Damage, blast right through 'em! Stack up those wins with me and let's aim for the top!

180.flavor_text: Now for the final stretch. Using Waza and Boost to their fullest is the key to victory. Win the battle and smash the opponent's Heart in one go, and a comeback win is well within reach!

181.name: Shinazui of the Flame
181.effect: ●When a card is Overbeat onto this Horobeat, if this Horobeat is downed, draw 1 card.
181.flavor_text: Want to know how we green fighters do it? First, just keep battling whatever stands in front of you. Power up one Horobeat through Overbeat and wait for Shinazuisho to arrive. The path to victory opens only for those who fight it out alone. That's our strategy.

182.flavor_text: Leftover Ena doesn't go to waste. At the end of your turn, you can draw cards equal to the Ena you didn't spend. That's Ena Draw! Or you can use that leftover Ena to Boost me. I'll burn even brighter and power up.

183.flavor_text: Win battles, destroy all of the opponent's Hearts, and deliver the finishing blow. That's how you win this game. Keep building your strength! Now, pay attention to the number on the left side of the card. Pay 1 Ena to use a Boost from your hand and power up.

186.name: Destined Meeting: Shinazui and Sho
186.effect: ●When a card is Overbeat onto this Horobeat, if this Horobeat is downed, draw 1 card.
186.flavor_text: Overbeat: the secret technique that lets you transform into a big, powerful fighter with minimal cost. Even a 9-cost mega Horobeat can Overbeat onto us for just 4 cost.

188.flavor_text: When you win a battle, you deal damage to both the opposing Horobeat and their Heart, Jan! On top of that, we get to draw too. Your hand is the key to victory, and the bigger it gets, the luckier things get, Jan!

189.flavor_text: An opponent's Heart cannot be destroyed in a single hit. Only by striking twice can it finally be destroyed. That is precisely why my Double Damage is so fearsome: two cuts at once, and the opposing Heart shatters in an instant. Kaka-ka!

193.flavor_text: The final stretch, the razor's edge between victory and defeat. Exploit the opponent's opening and press the attack on their Heart! Shatter it all at once and settle the match...!
